newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER SHOWCASE-RONALDO GOAL GIVES BARCELONA VICTORY.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER SHOWCASE-RONALDO GOAL GIVES BARCELONA VICTORY.

text.p: A solitary goal from Brazilian striker Ronaldo was enough to give Barcelona a 1-0 win over Real Madrid in a bad-tempered match between the arch-rivals on Saturday.
Both teams were lucky to finish with 11 players after a disappointing game which left Real a commanding five points clear of Barcelona with as many games remaining.
After losing to Real 2-0 earlier in the season, Barcelona will have to finish one point clear to take the title. Results of fixtures between teams decide final positions before goal difference.
The 106,000 crowd in the Camp Nou stadium had to wait until the 40th minute to see the first clear shot on goal.
A rash of chances for both sides before halftime ended with a penalty after Roberto Carlos fouled Barcelona winger Luis Figo.
Ronaldo saw his spot-kick saved by Bodo Illgner, but Figo clipped back the rebound for the Brazilian to knock in his 32nd goal of the season.
